issue_context.title: Add Description Field for Secrets and Variables
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Currently, Gitea does not provide a field for adding descriptions to secrets and variables in the repository settings. This makes it difficult for users to understand the purpose of a specific secret or variable, especially in larger projects with multiple contributors.
Thank you for considering this feature request!

### Screenshots

_No response_
comments:
I've added a basic description feature. For secrets, it works by replacing the ***** section and seems okay so far. But for variables, replacing the original values seems not well. Any other ideas?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a6f4d39-222a-44b5-8d74-4b5fdfb9f108)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aa81d727-5e3d-4efa-9550-8e88938ee63b)
Maybe always put 3 lines, secrets could put `****` and variables put `<value>`.

How about this? If there is a description, the icon appears, if not, there is no icon. There will be fewer extra lines and they will all have the same height.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2710aabb-8b05-4793-8fc4-f8b5b4794e4e)
I will try a 3 line layout first, using tips doesn't feel intuitive enough.

review_comments: I think we should return failure here because data should not be truncated.
It maybe very long, the length should be checked.
The field I've designed uses the TEXT data type in the database, with a current length limit of 65536 characters. If truncation is needed here, what would be an appropriate length to truncate it to?
I think we should return failure here because data should not be truncated.
